name: Computer Use
description: Observe and operate desktop or browser interfaces when dedicated tools cannot complete the request or visual verification is required.
progressive_guidance:
Follow the shortest sufficient path and verify only the requested outcome. Continue in a relevant existing app and window when possible; launch a new app only when the current workspace cannot satisfy the request. Do not switch apps solely to gain a richer control backend. When no relevant workspace exists, launch the app named by the owner or use their configured preference.
Work in the background by default. Use visible interaction when the owner asks to watch.
Treat requests to teach, explain, translate, summarize, or inspect visible content as read-only unless the owner also asks for a change. Analyze owner-provided images first and use computer use only for specific missing evidence. Do not click or edit visible fields merely to understand them.
Survey long pages once in one direction with page-sized scrolls and capture_after=true. Reuse each returned screenshot and stop at the end, when content repeats, or as soon as the evidence supports a useful answer. State precise uncertainty instead of browsing to eliminate every minor gap.
Open a dropdown only when its exact choices are required and not visible. Make one grounded attempt and at most one retry when the failure mode changes; then report that its choices could not be inspected.
